binding: Derek supplies this result in direct follow-up to the launched 59-degree trial in this thread. Attribution is from conversation context; photographs have no visible task identifier.
founder_quote: Not sure that made any difference at all. I do see this new defect along this vertical edge (first 4 photos), but leak on the bottom (last photo) appears in the same place, and perhaps worse.
result: Failed reported water hold; no demonstrated sealing improvement from the 59-degree transition trial.

observed.location: Vertical edge beside the curved wall
observed.finding: Repeated projecting thin strands/bristles and local roughness along the edge. Derek identifies this as a new defect.
observed.limits: Exact printed height, onset layer, strand attachment mechanism and any leak through this vertical edge are unverified.

observed.location: Floor underside at the branching perimeter-convergence region and perimeter
observed.finding: Several visible droplets, including larger drops near the branch. Derek reports bottom leakage in the same place and perhaps worse.
observed.limits: Water head, hold duration and leak rate are unreported; a quantitative worsening cannot be inferred from droplet sizes or photographs.

assessment: The nominal pocket-area reduction in the native comparison did not establish a successful physical sealing result. Do not carry the 59-degree setting forward as a demonstrated improvement.
curl_scope: No new corner-lift or onset observation is established by these off-plate photographs.
